view.summary: Sort boxes on a conveyor belt: gifts go to the Box District, Rapture boxes to the Rapture District. Correct sorts score points and charge Full Burst; mistakes stop you for a moment.

overview.title: A run
items: 1 Snowflake Gloves per run (Practice Mode is free but gives no rewards)
You can't sort for a short time (penalty value 100; likely 1/100 s, i.e. 1 s)

overview.title: Full Burst
items: 500 of 10,000, so 20 correct sorts fill it
2,000 at a time once active (5 steps to empty; likely 5 s)
Burst Gifts appear; they can go to either side and do not fill the gauge

overview.title: Difficulty
overview.note: Each level adds new box types and pays more per correct sort. The special gift and Burst Gift can show up at every level.
rows: Gift 1 (red), Rapture box 1, Gift 2 (green), Rapture box 2
Gift 1 (red), Rapture box 1, Gift 2 (green), Rapture box 2, Gift 3, Rapture box 3

overview.title: Ranks and rewards
overview.note: Your score at the end of a run decides your rank and its reward.
